route_note: Frequent Israel Railways trains run from Tel Aviv stations (Hashalom, Savidor) to Jerusalem Yitzhak Navon station in about 40 minutes, then take the light rail or a short bus ride into the Old City.
tour_query: Jerusalem day trip from Tel Aviv

route_note: Direct Israel Railways trains from Tel Aviv Savidor or Hashalom reach Haifa's Merkaz/Hashmona stations in under an hour; the Carmelit funicular or local buses connect to the Bahai Gardens and German Colony.
tour_query: Haifa and Bahai Gardens day trip from Tel Aviv

route_note: Take a train or bus to Hadera or Binyamina and continue by local bus or taxi to the Caesarea antiquities park, since the site itself has no station.
tour_query: Caesarea day trip from Tel Aviv

route_note: Israel Railways trains run from Tel Aviv to Akko station in about 1.5 hours, with a short walk or local bus from the station to the Old City.
tour_query: Acre Old City day trip from Tel Aviv

route_note: Trains from Tel Aviv to Beit Shemesh take about 40 minutes, then a local bus or taxi covers the last few kilometres to the Soreq Cave and Avshalom Reserve.
tour_query: Soreq Cave day trip from Tel Aviv
